headline: TC Energy Raises Profit Outlook and Announces $3B in Pipeline Projects
summary: TC Energy raised its profit outlook and announced $3 billion in new pipeline projects, projecting annual core profit growth of 5% to 7% through 2031.
why: Upgraded guidance and capital expenditure announcements signal management's confidence in future cash flows and infrastructure expansion.

impacts.name: TC Energy
impacts.why: Higher profit forecasts and growth projections typically support equity valuations.
